description: Statements that the electric power grid will fail or go down, power outages or blackouts (local, national, global), electricity cut off; the internet, communications, satellites, phones or electronics failing or being shut down, an internet blackout or kill switch; and the causes channelers name (solar flares, CMEs, an EMP, a Carrington event, cyber attacks, 'three days of darkness' or the Event only when power or technology fails with it). Not the theme: metaphysical grids, a media blackout, blackout as fainting, the Schumann chart's 'blackout'.
history: Merged on 2026-11-16 from three proposals of one sweep of the stored texts (grid, internet and prophetic lenses). Overlapping patterns were joined (blackout, outage, power outage, grid failure, cyber attack, cause with technology, Carrington event, darkness with technology), the narrow forms kept, the excludes scoped to the includes they guard, and patterns each lens measured below about 0.7 left out (bare grid, power grid, EMP, solar flash, days of darkness, satellites failing, GPS, kill switch, communication). Changes made after reading the joined labels (in-sample): lines_down, the failure verbs downed, burnt and bringing down, one more word in 'disrupt ... communications', lights going without 'out', carrington only as an event or storm, 'electricity goes out' without a determiner, and wider x_blackout_body and x_outage_metaphor. Review of 2026-11-16, after the coders' sample was drawn: examples that repeated or paraphrased stored text replaced by invented ones; a pattern branch copied from a stored sentence replaced by a general one; x_schumann, x_blackout_body, x_own_link, x_light_transformer, x_moon_satellite and x_dreamspell narrowed so that they cannot void a real failure named in the same sentence (each has keeps); power_outage takes 'fail' after a modal; the advice markers lost bare 'supplies' and 'warn...'; precision is measured per kind. Over every stored sentence and title the narrowed lexicon keeps exactly the hits the earlier one kept.
after_sample: Patterns changed after the coders' sample was drawn: power_outage (include) and the excludes x_schumann, x_blackout_body, x_own_link, x_light_transformer, x_moon_satellite and x_dreamspell, and markers.advice; no include was added. Each has its own after_sample note. None of them changes a stored hit (checked over every stored sentence and title on 2026-11-16); they matter for texts still to come (the owner's audio and captions).

sample.lexicon: the version before the review (sha1 a6e42b0f)
sample.note: The coders labelled what that version kept. The changes listed in after_sample came later; on the stored texts and titles they change no hit, so the sample still stands for the lexicon now.

format: include: id, topic, group (strong or weak, as pipeline/keywords.py reads it), pattern (Python re, matched case-insensitively against one sentence or one title, titles read with '_' as a space), optional kinds (source, made, captions, title; default all), optional screen (a cheap pattern every match contains, required for patterns that start with ^ or look ahead over .*), optional terms (what to report as the matched terms; default the match), precision (the lowest on-topic share among the kinds in measured.by_kind: a figure never pooled across kinds, for tools that read one number), measured (per kind: hits, distinct hits, labelled matches read, on, edge, off, precision with its Wilson interval; coded: the two coders' sample per kind) and examples (invented sentences it must match). exclude: id, pattern, scope (include ids or topics, or all), mode (unit: a match anywhere in the sentence voids the includes in scope; overlap: only include matches it overlaps; a look-ahead include's match is the whole sentence), optional kinds, why, examples (invented sentences in which it must void every include), keeps (invented sentences it must leave as they are, each still a hit), measured (per kind). after_sample: what changed after the coders' sample of 2026-11-16 was drawn (see sample). generic_topics: topics dropped from a hit that also has a more specific one. markers: the theme's warning words (advice to prepare), used beside prediction_timeline's future, prediction and hedge words.

include.notes: Any blackout, power or internet (the word does not say which). Needs the excludes for the Schumann chart, a news blackout and blackout as fainting or trance. Proposals: grid 25 of 26 source sentences and 9 of 12 YouTube titles on the theme; prophetic 27 of 35 (texts and titles). The second branch is for speech-to-text writing 'black out' as two words, only after a determiner or a power word (unmeasured: no stored match).

include.notes: A blackout named as one of power, the grid or electricity, or by a size that only power blackouts have here (rolling, national, regional). After the merge it has 0 stored matches: the stored blackouts are named by a place or a size (a country's blackout, a global or large-scale one), which does not say power or internet, so they stay 'unspecified'. measured.labels: The labels of the three lexicon sweeps of 2026-11-16 (grid, internet and prophetic lenses; one reader each; seeded samples of up to 20 per candidate pattern and every match of each lens's proposed patterns), joined to the texts as stored on 2026-11-16 (lexicon-merged/convert_labels.py: 1378 labels, 32 lost to changed texts). A sentence labelled by more than one lens takes the majority, a tie is edge. In-sample: the proposals were written on these labels, and the merge's own changes (lines_down, the wider failure verbs, the fixes to x_blackout_body and x_outage_metaphor, carrington only as an event) on the misses and false hits they showed; a fresh sample measures them. Precision is per kind (source, made, title; no captions are stored); a hash-only label that is no hit now is counted as missed. coded: the two coders of sample_2026-11-16 (63 blinded units drawn from scope all before the review), both coders on topic counted as on; it is the only out-of-sample measure.
